controls.title: Collection of evidence
controls.description: Establish and implement procedures for the identification, collection, acquisition, and preservation of evidence related to information security events to maintain integrity, credibility, and admissibility for disciplinary, legal, regulatory, and contractual purposes.

controls.title: Information security during disruption
controls.description: Ensure the continuity of information security processes and controls during business disruptions, ensuring that security measures remain effective even when normal operations are interrupted.

controls.title: ICT readiness for business continuity
controls.description: Establish and maintain ICT readiness to support business continuity objectives, including backup systems, failover mechanisms, and recovery procedures that align with business continuity plans.

controls.title: Legal, statutory, regulatory, and contractual requirements
controls.description: Identify, document, and comply with all legal, statutory, regulatory, and contractual requirements applicable to information security within the organization and relevant jurisdictions.

controls.title: Intellectual property rights
controls.description: Implement controls to protect the organization's intellectual property and ensure compliance with intellectual property rights legislation and contractual obligations.

controls.title: Protection of records
controls.description: Establish and implement procedures to protect records from unauthorized access, modification, destruction, and loss, ensuring their integrity and availability throughout their lifecycle.

controls.title: Privacy and protection of PII
controls.description: Implement appropriate controls to protect personally identifiable information (PII) and ensure compliance with privacy laws and regulations, including data protection principles.

controls.title: Independent review of information security
controls.description: Conduct independent periodic reviews and assessments of the information security management system to evaluate its effectiveness and identify areas for improvement.

controls.title: Compliance with policies, rules, and standards for information security
controls.description: Monitor and enforce compliance with information security policies, rules, procedures, and standards throughout the organization to maintain a consistent security posture.
